newsitem.title: USA: Colorado MEDtech Inc gives Q4 results.
newsitem.headline: Colorado MEDtech Inc gives Q4 results.

text.p: Colorado MEDtech Inc said on Tuesday net income in the fourth quarter ended June 30 rose to $575,885 from $311,507 in the fourth quarter a year ago.

Earnings per share for primary and fully diluted shares for the latest quarter increased to six cents from four cents last year following an increase of approximately 50 percent in the number of fully diluted equivalent shares outstanding.
Sales and services for the fourth quarter fell to $5,168,625 from $5,451,774 in the same period last year.
The company, which deals in custom medical products and services, on Tuesday provided results for the fourth quarter, which were not given in the full-year results released on September 10.
